tools.name: lint_hreflang
tools.description: Lint hreflang annotations for international SEO. Accepts pasted text (not a URL; this tool never fetches anything): page HTML with <link rel="alternate" hreflang> tags, an XML sitemap with xhtml:link alternates, or a JSON set {"pages":[{"url","canonical","alternates":[{"hreflang","href"}]}]}. Checks

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: lint_hreflang · Public sink: lint_hreflang.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: lint_hreflang · Public sink: lint_hreflang

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
